directBooking.title: Direct booking
directBooking.hint: Producers book straight from who can be asked.

offersByEmail.title: Asks go out by email
offersByEmail.hint: Artists answer from the email. Your timing settings decide whether it leaves at once or waits for the next daily send.

responseWindow.title: Answer by
responseWindow.hint: After it passes the ask expires and opens to who is asked next.

nothingToAccept.title: Nothing to accept
nothingToAccept.hint: An artist you add to a date is booked. It shows in their calendar as booked.

roleExplainer.linkLabel: See what each role can do

autoDrafted.title: Auto-drafted on fill
autoDrafted.hint: When a date fills, a draft contract is created from its booked cast.

issuingManual.title: Issuing is manual
issuingManual.hint: A producer reviews the draft and issues the PDF to the artist.

eligibilityFromCast.title: Who can be asked comes from your cast
eligibilityFromCast.hint: Your casts decide which dates you can be asked about.

offersArriveByEmail.title: Asks arrive by email
offersArriveByEmail.hint: Your producer's timing decides whether that is the daily send or the moment you are next in line.

responseWindow.title: You have a window to answer
responseWindow.hint: After it passes the ask expires and goes to whoever is asked next.

bookedDirectly.title: You are booked directly
bookedDirectly.hint: There is no ask step. A date booked for you appears in your calendar as booked.

blockingIsNo.title: Blocking is how you say no
blockingIsNo.hint: Dates you block come out of the list your producer books from, and that is where your say goes.
